title: 第9章 戏楼师娘第10章 秘药王掌柜
content_zh:
“路兄弟，实在对不住，有桩急事得劳你搭把手。”
刘奇搓着手，面色为难，“老爷急着要去戏楼，点名要我跟着伺候。可夫人方才又吩咐我去玲珑斋取新到的胭脂，我这实在是分身乏术啊。”
路沉收势抹了把汗
“这等小事，等你从戏楼回来顺路办了不成？”
“唉。”
刘奇叹声道“今晚戏楼，袁香香唱堂会，老爷是她的铁杆票友，这一去怕是得熬到三更天。可夫人那边老爷特意叮嘱要瞒着夫人的，这差事真是两头难做。”
路沉听罢，当即应承下来“刘兄放心，取胭脂的事包在我身上。”
“嘿，多谢路兄弟搭手。”
刘奇忙不迭从怀里摸出块碎银并一张字条。
“这是银钱和取货凭证，有劳了。”
路沉接过字条，状似随意地问道
“对了，刘兄既要随师父去戏楼，馆里这秘药煎制之事可有人接手？”
“唉，别提了，老爷吝啬，不肯多雇奴仆，内宅里统共就两个丫鬟、一个婆子，武馆是我和一个厨子，厨子是个外乡人，不好相处，他只管做饭，馆里的粗活杂事全落在我头上。今日又要伺候戏楼又要煎药，实在转不开身”
路沉顺势接过话头
“若是信得过，我来帮你煎药，往后煎好的药汤我顺手帮弟子们分发便是。刘兄专心伺候师父要紧。”
刘奇眼睛一亮，这简直是雪中送炭。
武馆的杂活就那几样，不算多。
偏生邓师父是个好玩的性子，经常出门，回回都点名要刘奇跟着。
他既要当车夫赶车，又要充当随从一路伺候，临了邓彦还总要沉着脸叮嘱“若让夫人知晓，仔细你的皮！”
为此刘奇没少误了馆里的差事。

有回煎药误了火候，被师娘撞个正着，任凭他如何解释，师娘只当是托词。
自那以后，师娘俨然把他当成了偷奸耍滑的主。
想到这儿，刘奇忙不迭拱手“路兄弟仗义，我正愁今日该咋办呢，路兄弟雪中送炭，刘某感激不尽！”
他说着从腰间解下药房钥匙塞给路沉。
“药材都在西厢药柜里，每包分量都是配好的，煎药的陶罐摆在灶房北角，有劳兄弟了！”
刘奇千恩万谢地拱手离去后。
路沉揣着字条和碎银，走到东城东市的玲珑阁。
铺子门面不大，脂粉香气扑鼻。
柜台后的伙计抬了抬眼皮“客官是取货还是现挑？”
路沉将字条和碎银推过去。
伙计展开字条瞥了眼，转身从货架上取来个锦盒，拈了拈路沉递来的碎银，从柜台下取出戥子与银剪，利落地剪下一块，放在戥星上仔细称量。
见分量略多，又剪去一角，这才将剩下的碎银连同锦盒一并推回路沉面前
“邓夫人订的茉莉头油、梨红胭脂，海棠唇脂，收您三钱整，找您一钱。”
路沉捏了捏找回的碎银，确认分量无差，这才提起锦盒走出玲珑阁。
寒风萧瑟。
天寒地冻。
路沉瞥见街角杂货摊的簸箕簸箕里堆着七八个晒得焦黄的葫芦，心念微动，走上前问
“老丈，葫芦怎卖？”
“三文。”摊主呵着白气跺脚，“都是晒透的秋葫芦，装水不渗，密实得很。”
路沉拣了个匀称的，拔开木塞，借着天光瞧见内壁干爽，便数出三枚铜子，拿了葫芦走了。

邓宅在武馆后巷。
与前面练武的喧闹院子仅一墙之隔。
路沉穿过一条窄巷，便瞧见一扇黑漆木门，门楣上刻着几枝疏影横斜的梅花。
路沉抬手叩响门环，片刻，门开了一条缝，露出个梳着双鬟的小丫鬟，她眨着眼打量路沉这一身粗布棉袄“你是哪位？”
“武馆弟子路沉，来给师娘送胭脂。”
content_en:
"Brother Lu, I'm really sorry. I need your help with something urgent."
Liu Qi rubbed his hands and looked embarrassed, "The master is in a hurry to go to the theater and asked me to wait on you. But just now, my wife ordered me to go to Linglong Zhai to pick up the newly arrived rouge. I am really busy with my time."
Lu Chen stopped and wiped his sweat.
"Can you handle such a small matter on your way back from the theater?"
"Alas."
Liu Qi sighed and said, "Tonight, Yuan Xiangxiang is singing in the theater. I am a die-hard fan of hers. I am afraid that I will have to stay up until the middle of the night. But the master specifically told me to hide it from my wife. This job is really difficult to do at both ends."
After Lu Chen heard this, he immediately agreed, "Brother Liu, don't worry, I will take care of the rouge."
"Hey, thanks for helping me, Brother Lu."
Liu Qi hurriedly took out a piece of broken silver and a note from his arms.
"Here's the money and the receipt for picking up the goods. Thank you."
Lu Chen took the note and asked casually
"By the way, since Brother Liu is going to the theater with Master, can someone take over the decoction of the secret medicine in the theater?"
"Oh, forget it. The master is stingy and refuses to hire more servants. There are only two maids and a woman in the inner house. The martial arts hall is between me and a cook. The cook is a stranger and is difficult to get along with. He only cooks and all the menial chores in the hall fall on me. Today I have to serve the theater and cook medicine. I really can't turn away."
Lu Chen took the opportunity to take over the conversation
"If you can trust me, I will help you boil the medicine. Then I will distribute the cooked medicine to the disciples. Brother Liu, it is important to concentrate on serving Master."
Liu Qi's eyes lit up, this was a timely help.
There are just a few chores in the martial arts studio, not much.
Unexpectedly, Master Deng had a fun-loving temperament. He often went out and asked Liu Qi to follow him every time.
He not only had to be the coachman driving the carriage, but also had to serve as a follower to wait on him all the way. When Deng Yan came, he would always tell Deng Yan with a stern face, "If you let Madam know, watch your skin carefully!"
For this reason, Liu Qi often missed his errands in the library.
There was a time when the decoction was cooked by mistake, and the master's wife bumped into him. No matter how he explained it, the master's wife only regarded it as an excuse.
From then on, the mistress seemed to treat him as a cheating master.
Thinking of this, Liu Qi hurriedly handed over his hand, "Brother Lu is so generous. I was worried about what to do today. Brother Lu came to help me in times of need. Liu is grateful!"
As he said this, he took off the pharmacy key from his waist and gave it to Lu Chen.
"The medicinal materials are all in the medicine cabinet in the west wing, and each package is pre-packaged. The pottery pots for decoction are placed in the north corner of the kitchen. Thank you, brother!"
Liu Qi gratefully handed over his hand and left.
Lu Chen carried the note and broken silver and walked to Linglong Pavilion in Dongcheng Dongshi.
The store has a small facade and the fragrance of powder is fragrant.
The clerk behind the counter raised his eyelids and said, "Sir, do you want to pick up the goods or pick them up now?"
Lu Chen pushed the note and broken silver over.
The clerk opened the note and glanced at it, then turned around and took a brocade box from the shelf, picked up the broken silver handed over by Lu Shen, took out the box and silver scissors from under the counter, cut off a piece neatly, put it on the star and weighed it carefully.
Seeing that the weight was slightly too much, he cut off another corner, and then pushed the remaining pieces of silver together with the brocade box back in front of Lu Chen
"Mrs. Deng ordered jasmine hair oil, pear red rouge, and crabapple lip balm. I'll charge you three yuan and give you one yuan."
Lu Chen pinched the broken silver he found to make sure the weight was correct, then he picked up the brocade box and walked out of Linglong Pavilion.
The cold wind blows.
It's freezing cold.
Lu Chen caught a glimpse of seven or eight sun-brown gourds piled in the dustpan of the street corner grocery stall. His thoughts moved slightly and he stepped forward to ask.
"Old man, how can I sell gourds?"
"Sanwen." The stall owner breathed the white air and stamped his feet, "They are all sun-dried autumn gourds. They can hold water without leaking and are very dense."
Lu Chen picked a well-proportioned one, pulled out the cork, and saw that the inner wall was dry in the sky. He counted three copper coins, took the gourd and left.
Deng's house is in the back alley of the martial arts school.
It is only separated from the noisy courtyard where martial arts is practiced in front by a wall.
After passing through a narrow alley, I saw a dark wooden door with several branches carved on the lintel.Plum blossoms with sparse shadows and slanting shadows.
Lu Chen raised his hand and knocked on the door knocker. After a moment, the door opened a crack, revealing a little maid with her hair combed. She blinked and looked at Lu Chen's coarse cotton-padded jacket. "Who are you?"
"Martial arts disciple Lu Chen is here to give rouge to his wife."
